summary: Baseline-only backend performance benchmark completed before Redis implementation. Added reusable read-only benchmark runner and captured /api/rf/catalog, /api/rf/cards, and internal fresh_deck timings with payload hashes and protected-data guard snapshots.

critical.issue: Function loads the full subject pool each call via to_list(12000) before dedupe/shuffle. This is O(pool_size) per request and is the primary backend hotspot to optimize (candidate for Redis/materialized selection/index strategy).

action_items: Implement optimization (Redis/index/query-path) without changing response payload semantics for /api/rf/catalog and /api/rf/cards.
After implementation, rerun: python /app/backend/tests/perf_api_benchmark.py --label after and compare p50/p95 plus payload_hash_first/payload_hash_unique_count fields.
Preserve read-only guard invariants (profiles, coins_sum, wallet_ownership, neet_profile_stats).
critical_code_review_comments: Baseline confirms data integrity remained unchanged: protected snapshot before/after matches reference hashes and counts.
Both public endpoints were stable and deterministic in this run (all 200; unique payload hash count = 1 for local and external samples).
External preview p95 spike observed on catalog (~324ms) while local internal remained lower; likely ingress/network variance on first external sample, not payload drift.

success_rate.backend: 100% (requested baseline measurements completed; verifier test passed 1/1)

seed_data_creation: No seed or mutating data created. Read-only benchmark only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the same runner with --label after for strict before/after comparability. Do not alter benchmark sample sizes (fresh_deck N=15, local endpoints N=10, external N=8) when measuring implementation impact.
rca_of_issue: Primary latency hotspot is algorithmic: fresh_deck currently fetches broad card pool and performs in-process shuffle/dedup/grouping each request. This creates avoidable per-request DB read + Python CPU overhead that scales with pool size.
